project_name: AzoApp Merchant - Premium Financial & KYC Module UI/UX Redesign

brand_identity.design_aesthetic: Enterprise SaaS Fintech, Stripe-level precision, trustworthy, clean, minimal, data-driven, high-end

scale.subtitle: text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium
scale.small_label: text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

hero_wallet_card.description: Gradient header background (#0D47A1 into deep navy) with available balance, action CTAs, withdrawable trend indicator and security badge
hero_wallet_card.desktop_layout: Flex/Grid split: Available balance on left, Withdraw & Deposit actions on right, supporting metric pills below
hero_wallet_card.mobile_layout: Stacked card with sticky quick CTA, high-contrast white text, clear touch targets

kpi_card.description: Clean 1px bordered card, 16px radius, soft shadow, icon container with subtle brand tint, trend percentage badge, subtext

right_side_drawer.description: Shadcn Sheet / Drawer component sliding from right on desktop (min 480px width), full-screen overlay sheet on mobile
right_side_drawer.content: Deep transaction metadata, timeline step tracker, status badge, receipt download, audit log

stepper.desktop: Horizontal progress track with numbered step badges, titles, and step connectors
stepper.mobile: Compact header showing 'Step X of 4' with progress bar and current step title

responsive_tables.desktop: Shadcn Table with sortable column headers, fixed header option, hover rows, clear action triggers
responsive_tables.mobile: Card list view with key info upfront, status tag, expandable chevron for instant drawer view

sections: Hero Wallet Section (Available Balance, Withdrawable, Pending, Withdrawn, 'Withdraw Money' CTA)
KYC Blocker Warning (If incomplete: non-intrusive alert with 'Complete Bank & KYC' CTA)
Summary KPI Grid (Total Earned, Commission, Processing, Available, Pending, Withdrawn)
Segmented Tabs (Overview, Transactions, Withdrawals)
Overview Tab (Earnings Trend Chart, Recent Transactions Timeline, Recent Withdrawals)
Transactions Tab (Search, Date/Type/Status/Amount Filters, Desktop Table / Mobile Card List, Right Drawer)
Withdrawals Tab (History Table, Status Badges, Processing Times)
Multi-Step Withdraw Dialog Flow (Step 1 Amount -> Step 2 Select Bank -> Step 3 Review -> Step 4 OTP/Confirm -> Step 5 Success)
KYC Progress Bar Header (Completion stage e.g. 3/4 Verified)
PAN Card Verification Card (PAN input, Document Upload dropzone, Uploaded preview, Verification Status)
Bank Account Cards Grid (Bank logo/icon, Masked account number, IFSC, Primary badge, Set Primary/Edit/Remove/Verify actions)
Add Bank Account Form Dialog (Inline IFSC lookup validation, Savings/Current option)
Security & Compliance Footer (Shield icon, 256-bit encryption message, RBI compliance note)
Approved & Locked Banner (Shown when verified: 'Profile approved & locked', Verified Merchant badge)
4-Step Stepper Navigation (1. Owner Info -> 2. Shop Info -> 3. Address & Location -> 4. Review & Submit)
Step 1 Owner: Live photo capture, full name, phone, email, DOB
Step 2 Shop: Business name, service category, description, shop photos multi-upload with previews
Step 3 Address: Street address, city, district, state, pincode, interactive location selector
Step 4 Review: Detailed section summaries with 'Edit' triggers and final verification submission CTA
KPI Cards Row (Total Commission, This Month, Pending, Paid, Growth %)
Interactive Daily Commission Chart (Recharts ResponsiveContainer, 7d/30d/3m/6m/1y toggles, custom tooltip, peak highlight)
Commission Source Breakdown (Referral, Booking, Network, Bonus, Adjustment distribution bar/donut)
Advanced Filter & Search Toolbar (Search ID, Source, Date range picker, Status filter, Mobile full-screen filter sheet)
Paginated Commission Transactions Table (Date, Txn ID, Source, Base Amount, Commission Rate, Earned, Status, Action Drawer)

framer_motion_presets.page_fade_in: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' }}
framer_motion_presets.drawer_slide_in: initial={{ x: '100%' }} animate={{ x: 0 }} exit={{ x: '100%' }} transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 300 }}

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All buttons, inputs, tabs, table rows, drawer triggers, status badges, and modals MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='withdraw-money-button', data-testid='bank-account-card-0')
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px target area on all interactive elements in mobile views
accessibility_and_testing.focus_management: Visible ring-2 ring-[#0D47A1] offset-2 on focused interactive controls
